_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): a complete marketing/landing website in ONE call — frontend only (project-frontend + comp-landing + comp-page + error boundary + http client), no backend. No new code: pure composition.
name: stack-landing
description: Complete marketing website: React landing page (hero, features, sections, footer) + data pages + error boundaries. Frontend-only greenfield in one call.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Frontend project name, e.g. 'acme-site' (drives package.json and the Vite scaffold)

variables.name: api_base
variables.description: API base for the frontend's http client (empty = static site without API)

notes: Marketing site starter. After applying: npm install, mount <Landing brand='YourBrand' heroTitle='...' heroSubtitle='...' ctaLabel='Get started' features={[...]} /> in App, add content pages with <Page fetchPath={...}> for data sections or plain sections for static content.
